name: Eroded blackland-clay cut bank with roots
in_game: Replaces the 'natural bank' (terrain vertex paint + the wet band) on undeveloped and park shore facing a long fetch
real: Waves at the pool cut a notch in the Blackland Prairie clay; the face above slumps in blocks and stands near vertical 1-2 m high, tan-grey with paler calcareous layers, dark topsoil and grass at the lip, roots hanging out of the top half metre. A narrow bench of clay, gravel and clam shells at the toe, slumped blocks lying on it, a wrack line of sticks.
